key_concepts: Energy exists in various forms such as light, sound, and heat.
Energy can be transferred from one object to another.
Energy can cause changes in objects.
Energy can be transformed from one form to another.
The Sun is a source of energy for living and non-living things.
Energy transformations can turn less useful forms of energy into useful forms.
Light energy is associated with the emission of visible light.
Light energy can light up a room and drive photosynthesis in plants.
Common light sources include electric lights, sunlight, and candles.
Not all objects are light sources; some objects only reflect light.
Saving energy means using only the energy needed and avoiding waste.
Safety and fire prevention are important when dealing with energy sources and devices.
